title: SDW100 2027 Infopack — official
claims: The SDW100 is a 100 mile continuous point to point trail race along the South Downs Way, from Matterley Bowl near Winchester to Eastbourne, held over the weekend of 12–13 June 2027, with a 30 hour limit and cut-offs at every aid station.
Runners begin with a loop of the Matterley Estate and must not recce the first 5 miles, which is entirely private land.

The infopack sets a minimum age of 20 on race day and publishes the mandatory kit list, including a charged mobile phone, at least 1 litre of water capacity, a 1.4 m x 2 m survival blanket, a waterproof jacket with sealed seams, a whistle, a 100 lumen headtorch and backup from Washington, a dry long-sleeved base layer, and a cup.
Pacers may accompany runners at any stage after the Kithurst Hill crew point, but not more than one pacer at a time.

Drop bag locations are given as Washington at mile 54, Housedean Farm at mile 76 and the finish at Eastbourne at mile 100; drop bags are transported to the finish for 0630 on Sunday and uncollected bags are disposed of after 1230 on Sunday.
Cut-off times on the aid station chart are deadlines for leaving the aid station, not for arriving.
The page tells runners that a downloadable GPX of the route can be found at the bottom of the page.
The page embeds checkpoint map points as location attributes; the Matterley Bowl point is 51.051114, -1.246487.
